requirements.evidence: The contract is present end to end: routes/web.php:59-60 adds entity.queues/entity.serve; app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:23-248 has every listed property/method and app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:40-53,63-102 has the serve state and callNext(); resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php and serve.blade.php render the required list, modals, queue/mode selectors, waiting list and aria-labelled call button; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:66,74,88 plus members.blade.php:7-20 add the tabs; lang/en/ui.php and lang/pt_BR/ui.php contain every required key; resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:45-52 adds both nav links. Edge cases are handled: foreign ids are scoped with findOrFail (Queues.php:102,116,171,182,230; Serve.php:73), the three modes and 30-row cap are applied (Serve.php:146-159), inactive/empty notices and successful-call rate limiting are implemented (Serve.php:78-102), and closeQueue resets nested state (Queues.php:110,238).

conventions.evidence: Uses the existing actions (CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket) instead of new domain code, policies via authorize, #[Validate] on name/renameName (Queues.php:29,53), scoped Eloquent reads, lang files and sibling Bulma markup. Deviations: $mode is client-writable but lacks #[Validate] and is handled with CallMode::tryFrom/abort_if (Serve.php:45,75-76); only CHANGELOG.md:21 is updated, with no docs/ sync; role/policy logic sits in Blade at queues.blade.php:140.

security.evidence: Strong baseline: #[Locked] entity and lastCalledTicketId (Queues.php:23-24, Serve.php:50-51), scoped queues()/memberships() findOrFail for every client id (Queues.php:102,116,171,182,230; Serve.php:73), authorize on create/rename/toggle/access (Queues.php:71,116,133,157,171,182), rate limiting on successful calls (Serve.php:78-102), and all output through {{ }}. Gaps: openQueue() has no re-authorization (Queues.php:102), and render() builds accessQueue/accessMemberships/accessGrants from client-writable accessQueueId/managingAccess without a manageAccess check (Queues.php:207-224).

tests.evidence: Pest coverage is broad: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:13-284 covers create, duplicate validation, list, rename, toggle, access, foreign tamper, close/reset, demotion, locale and nav; tests/Feature/Entity/ServePanelTest.php:57-329 covers defaults, grants, modes, ordering, 30-cap, channel, exceptions, forbidden call, tampered mode, locked property, rate limit and page access; tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTabsTest.php:13-56 covers tab switching, ignored values and fallback. Gaps: no unauthorized/demotion test for several actions and no non-member 403 test for Serve (ServePanelTest.php:299).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing actions, policies, Queue/QueueAccess models, lang files and the default-page layout; no service/repository layer and no speculative abstractions. The markup mirrors the existing members page, and the extra view data (accessMemberships) and modal markup are direct rather than generalized prematurely.

readability.evidence: Clear names/comments and small focused methods in both components; untrusted state is documented (Queues.php:38,60, Serve.php:40,45). Minor issues: resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:119-121,140 contains long label/class ternaries and an inline \App\Models\UserRole check; Queues.php:102,116,171,182 accepts untyped $queueId; domainError() declares : string but returns first(), which can be null (Queues.php:248).

scope.evidence: Only task-related files change: routes, the two Livewire components and views, Members tabs, lang files, navbar, CHANGELOG and tests. No unrelated refactors or features; the extra lang keys (queues_name, serve_mode_*, etc.) directly support the new UI.

issues.explanation: openQueue() resolves the id scoped but never calls $this->authorize('update', $queue), unlike startRename() at :116 and toggleActive() at :171; after a mid-session demotion a manager can still open the detail modal, although the write actions remain protected.

render() fills accessQueue, accessMemberships and accessGrants from the client-writable accessQueueId/managingAccess without checking manageAccess; openAccess() authorizes, but a demoted or removed manager can set the public state directly (as tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:198 does) and read members' names/emails and grants.

The suite tests a foreign accessQueueId but not a valid queue after demotion, and it has no unauthorized/tamper test for rename via a tampered editingQueueId, confirmToggle via viewingQueueId, revokeAccess, closeCreate/cancelRename/closeAccess, or a non-member 403 on entity.serve (ServePanelTest.php:299); the Livewire policy asks for an unauthorized and a tamper test for each action.

mode is a public client-writable property but lacks #[Validate]; it is validated through CallMode::tryFrom and abort_if(..., 422) at :75-76, which is safe but deviates from the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.
Only the changelog is updated in the diff; the docs-sync convention asks to check README/docs for new routes and pages, and no docs/ change accompanies the new pages.

The UserRole check uses a fully-qualified class name inside Blade, and the label/class ternaries at :119-121 put formatting logic in the view; a computed property, accessor or small Blade component would be easier to read and test.

review.summary: The change implements the queue-management page, attendant serve panel, members tabs and navbar entries with scoped ID resolution, policy checks, rate limiting, both locales and a broad Pest suite. The task is essentially complete; the remaining concerns are limited read-path re-authorization (openQueue and the access modal), a few missing per-action unauthorized/tamper tests, and small convention/readability nits, so I would approve with those changes.
